title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1987-06-20
source: Source: Previously unreleased Cassette original master. Nakamichi CM-300s/CP4 Shotguns -> Sony Walkman Pro/ (Triad Metal-Position MG-X 90 for Set 1 and Maxell MX 90 for Set 2) -> JVC TD-W354 -> Zoom H6 -> WAV 96/24 -> Audacity -> FLAC 96/24; Recorded, tracked and seeded by bltz

ai_review.summary: Exceptionally clean audience recording of the June 1987 show, though performance details are scarce.
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer praises this source as the clearest‑sounding audience (AUD) tape they’ve heard from the concert, indicating a very high‑quality capture. No specific comments on the musical performance or setlist were provided, so the show itself remains uncharacterized beyond the excellent audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it is strongly positive about the audio quality; no performance data limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes it as the cleanest‑sounding audience recording of this show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No performance or pacing comments were given in the review.
